newsitem.title: USA: Aura says final SEC report seeks no action.
newsitem.headline: Aura says final SEC report seeks no action.

text.p: Aura Systems Inc said on Thursday a full report by the Securities and Exchange Commission concerning inquiries into Aura's business practices requires no further action by Aura or its chief executive.
Aura said the SEC did not allege that Aura Chief Executive Officer Zvi Kurtzman or anyone else personally benefited in any way from events investigated by the SEC.
The SEC did not require Aura to amend any of its prior reports filed with the SEC, nor did it seek any monetary penalties from Aura, Kurtzman or a former Aura officer.
"We are pleased to be able to finally put the matter behind us," the company said.

In June Aura said it had agreed in principle with the SEC to settle issues. It also said the SEC intended to allege that Aura violated reporting and bookkeeping provisions of securities laws in its dealings with Micro Computer Distribution Power and John Jory Corp.
